tagline: Europe's leading airport operator managing major transport hubs across Spain and international destinations
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue represents Aena's primary operational metric, reflecting airport activity levels across its network. The 1,238 million euros for H1 2020 captures the significant pandemic-driven decline in passenger traffic and airport services.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company during the period.
kpis.description: Revenue for the six-month period ended 30 June 2020 amounts to 1,238 million euros. Data extracted from condensed consolidated interim financial statements.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline due to 2020 pandemic impact

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 58.2% for the six-month period ended 30 June 2020, demonstrating operational resilience despite pandemic disruptions.
kpis.signal: High gross margin despite crisis conditions

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is 22.1% for the half-year period, reflecting effective cost management during a challenging operating environment.
kpis.signal: Resilient operating margin despite pandemic headwinds

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital spending on property, plant and equipment and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reached 189 million euros during the first half of 2020, demonstrating ongoing commitment to airport infrastructure modernization and expansion.
kpis.signal: Capex maintained despite crisis to support infrastructure

kpis.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents reached 2,184 million euros at 30 June 2020, compared to 241 million euros at 31 December 2019, driven by proactive liquidity management and pandemic-related financing activities.

risks.title: Airport tariff regulation (DORA)
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first position in the operational section, with strong language ("applicable regulation", "limits to activities"), stable trend, and represents a central issue for Aena's business model.

risks.title: Brexit impact on air traffic
risks.score_rationale: Brexit is explicitly identified as a major operational risk, with concerned language ("uncertain outcome", "without agreement"), stable trend, and directly affects passenger flows.

risks.title: Dependence on passenger traffic
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the document, with strong language ("directly linked", "traffic levels"), stable trend, and fundamental to Aena's revenues.

risks.title: Cybersecurity-related risks
risks.score_rationale: While not detailed here, cyber risk is implicit in modern operational threats to critical infrastructure. Regulatory language and sector nature justify high severity, upward trend.

risks.title: Increased competition among European airports
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implied by sensitivity to traffic and airline decisions. Language on operating conditions and regulatory environment indicates competitive pressure, upward trend.

risks.title: Safety and environmental regulation
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions regulatory developments in safety and environment. Constraining language ("could limit", "significant spending"), stable trend.
